MS AMI N BHATT(3372) for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR KI SHAH(766) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 2 MR JK SHAH, APP for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018
ORAL ORDER
This Criminal Revision Application is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat, today.
Learned APP Shri JK Shah appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has produced Withdrawal/Settlement purshis, which is taken on record.
Today, Mr. D. K. Patel, Food Safety Officer from the Surat Municipal Corporation, Surat is present before the Court.
He stated that the original complainant Mr. N. P. Vyas has retired from service, and therefore, he is present on his behalf.

Designated Officer, Surat Municipal Corporation has also issued a letter of authority in his favour to remain present stating that as the matter is placed in the Lok Adalat before this Court and if the applicant is ready and willing to deposit the amount of fine, let the matter be disposed of.

In presence of learned advocate for the R/CR.RA/466/2005 ORDER Corporation, a zerox copy of the PAN card of the appellant- Amrutlal Narsinhdas Modi, who is also present before the Court, is taken on record.
In view of the withdrawal / settlement pursis moved by the parties under the signature as well as learned advocate appearing on behalf of the parties.

sentences.text: As such, on going through the record, it is noticed that the offence alleged against the original accused-revisionist under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 is not serious in nature and the punishment or penalty for such offence is not substantial, and in view of the provisions of Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.

It is pointed out that by virtue of an Order dated 27th June 2005 passed by this Court, pending hearing and final disposal of the present Criminal Revision Application, the execution,
implementation and operation of the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 17th July 1997 passed by the learned J.M.F.C., Surat in P.F.A. Case No. 3 of 1994 and which was confirmed by the learned Presiding Officer, 10th Fast Track Court, Surat vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 45 of 1997 dated 22.06.2005 has been suspended and the applicant/revisionist is ordered to be released on bail.
In view of purshis of the parties, the present Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of.

The applicant/revisionist is hereby directed to pay fine of Rs. 25,000/= [Rupees Twenty Five thousand only] before the High R/CR.RA/466/2005 ORDER Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad within a period of four weeks of this Order; as agreed, failing which the Criminal Revision Application shall stand revived automatically.

entities.text: High R/CR.RA/466/2005 ORDER Court Legal Services Committee, High Court of Gujarat Complex, Ahmedabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, this Criminal Revision Application stands disposed of as settled on payment of fine; as aforestated.

The judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 17th July 1997 passed by the learned J.M.F.C., Surat in P.F.A. Case No. 3 of 1994 and which was confirmed by the learned Presiding Officer, 10th Fast Track Court, Surat vide judgment and order passed in Criminal Appeal No. 45 of 1997 dated 22.06.2005 stands modified by converting the same into fine of Rs. 25,000/=
[Rupees Twenty Five thousand only].
Bail bonds stand cancelled.
R&P; if any, be transmitted back to the trial Court.

It is required to be mentioned here that disposal of this matter will not in any way affect any connected cases arising out of the same, incident or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this Order will not be treated as precedent in any future cases for reference.
